map.总模块数 = 95（左右各 6 位 + 分隔符 + 护线）: Total modules = 95 (6 digits each side + separator + guard bars)
map.EAN-13 用 13 位数字表示商品，前 2–3 位为国家/地区前缀（中国 6: EAN-13 represents a product with 13 digits: the first 2–3 digits are the country/region prefix (690–695 for China), followed by the manufacturer code and the product code, with the last digit as the check digit. Structurally the code splits into two halves of 6 digits: each digit on the left uses encoding set A or B, chosen according to the first digit (which is why the first digit has no bars of its own); the right half uses encoding C uniformly. The halves are separated by 01010 and flanked by 101 guard bars, for a total width of 95 modules. The check digit uses weighted modulo 10: the first 12 digits are weighted alternately by 1 and 3, and the complement to 10 of the remainder is taken.

map.EAN-13 的校验位怎么算？: How is the EAN-13 check digit calculated?
map.取前 12 位，从左到右按 1、3、1、3… 交替加权求和，用 10 减去「和除: Take the first 12 digits and sum them with alternating weights of 1, 3, 1, 3… from left to right. Subtract the remainder of that sum divided by 10 from 10, then take the result modulo 10 to get the 13th digit. For example, if the sum leaves a remainder of 3, the check digit is 7; a remainder of 0 gives a check digit of 0.
map.EAN-8 和 EAN-13 怎么选？: Should you use EAN-8 or EAN-13?
map.EAN-13 用于常规商品，占 95 个模块；EAN-8 只有 8 位、占 67: EAN-13 is used for regular products and occupies 95 modules; EAN-8 has only 8 digits and occupies 67 modules, for products whose packaging is too small to fit 13 digits (such as chewing gum or small snack packs). EAN-8 codes are allocated separately by the national numbering authority from within the existing EAN-13 manufacturer code.
